The candidate selected C, which is actually the TRUE statement (females are produced from fertilized eggs). The correct answer is A, because male bees (drones) are haploid (n) and develop from unfertilized eggs via parthenogenesis, meaning they do not produce sperm through meiosis; their sperm is produced via mitosis, making the sperm genetically identical to the male bee. Therefore, statement A is false.
